note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles and cross-checked by Planet GTA 6. Every guide below is written for this entry in its own words; where a method is not yet confirmed by any published guide, the guide says so and sticks to what the official description implies.

ggrecon.name: GGRecon — GTA 6's trophy list is out

keengamer.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

pushsquare.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: The last trophy you earn. It pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do for it directly — follow the roadmap, finish the 100% checklist for A Long Road, and this follows on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to the end. It is the first mission of the game, so this pops early in Chapter 1 and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it lands a beat late.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, this one comes from playing the story through — no side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Before you leave this chapter, run the Race Against Yago if it has appeared — Output Lag reports it as time-sensitive, and it feeds the Earn Cash, Not Kudos race count.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. By now the robbery trophies should be opening up, so start the bank vaults and gang operations alongside the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back if you want to replay the ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Story-mission trophies pop at the end of the mission named in the description — play it through and this one is yours.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a set-piece heist mission, so follow the mission's own objectives and the trophy pops when it ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy, it is unmissable — finish the mission and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops with it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The airport comes back later for the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so note the layout while you are here.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A late-story mission trophy — finish it and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist unlocks after the story (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion, per Push Square) and covers story missions, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries. Push Square notes only 15 of the 18 card sets count toward it, so the thresholds are more forgiving than completing everything. Expect a long grind — PowerPyx estimates around 200 hours to the platinum, Push Square up to 300 or more.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts. Push Square counts 397 stunts in the game, so you need a little over half of them. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses and airtime moments the game tracks — work them into normal driving and check your count under Progress.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once (GTABase lists nine types). Sample one of each — races, fishing, bowling, the arcade, the shooting range, drone races, meditation and the rest — rather than grinding any single one.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (Push Square). Ranges are scored on accuracy and speed, so use a steady weapon, take the time-bonus targets first, and replay any challenge that lands silver until it turns gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. Learn one track at a time — drone races reward clean lines over raw speed, so fly the racing line and cut corners only where you can see the next gate.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix race types as they unlock. One race, Race Against Yago in Chapter 3, is reported time-sensitive (Output Lag), so run it as soon as it appears.
trophies.caution: Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) is reported time-sensitive — run it when it appears.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head catches — match Cal's spots and keep your line tension steady rather than reeling flat out.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to end. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through — you only need one completion.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands unlock as the story progresses — keep returning to Andy's marker whenever it appears on the map.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Like the other stranger finales, it unlocks as the story opens up new parts of Leonida — answer the strand's calls when they come.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Start the strand as soon as it appears so its missions do not pile up at the end of the game.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than 8 strangers, so pick the strands you like — each one ends with a finale mission, and the five named character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) each carry their own trophy too.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Randy's strand is one of the five named finales that also count toward the 8 strands of Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Finish the strand when it unlocks rather than leaving it for the post-story cleanup.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close (Output Lag), and each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters — bring your partner every time. Do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 first: one morning after she is home, following the mission Down to Earth (Output Lag), she walks out to the balcony — follow her and take the optional meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and while no guide has confirmed it counts toward the 18, GTABase and PowerPyx both flag it as the one thing that could lock the platinum. Do it before you leave Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia disappears after Chapter 1. It is unconfirmed whether it counts toward the 18 spots — do it anyway, before leaving Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at one specific animal — follow his strand, track the animal he names, and take the shot when you have a clean one.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game (Push Square) and only 3 are needed here, so finish the three easiest sets you find first. Cards are scattered across Leonida, often in shops and out-of-the-way spots — collect as you travel.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo and share feature — open it at landmarks, viewpoints and districts as you explore and the count climbs. Do it as you travel rather than as a separate sweep at the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small objectives the game tracks under Progress — stunts, driving feats, combat feats and more. They pile up through normal play, so check Progress to see which categories are close and finish those first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Get the heat up with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, keep each robbery quick, and do not let the wanted level drop between them — speed matters more than the take.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new model you drive for the first time counts — steal, borrow and test-drive widely, and check the vehicle list under Progress to see what you have found and what is still missing.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies with one use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group, trigger Combat Focus when they are clustered, and chain the kills before the meter runs out — a gang hideout or a shootout with cover works best.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave the airport by an aircraft that is not on the schedule. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet — the description points at VCIA itself, so the trophy is about departing the airport in an unscheduled way. Try taking a plane off the runway rather than leaving through the front gate.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the tanks. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet; the trophy is about the Rhino tank, so find one (they appear at high wanted levels and at military spots), get in it or take one on, and the rest should follow.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — wait for the shop to be empty, stay out of the clerk's line of sight, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults are the big jobs — plan each one, bring your partner where the job allows, and make the getaway clean. The count is five, so repeat until the fifth escape.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes — ambush one away from police, crack it open, and lose the wanted level before you bank the cash.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every area of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive the highways, the coast and the swamps, and check the map for blank regions you have never entered. Pair it with the WAiNK and vehicle hunts so one trip counts twice.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang. Gang operations are marked as you find them — work through the gangs one at a time and keep a note of which gangs you have already hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description is the whole hint: find a bar or a spot on Ocean Beach with a view and order a cocktail. No guide has confirmed the exact spot yet — this is what the description implies, not a verified location.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through the glass and out of a vehicle showroom. No guide has confirmed the exact showroom yet; the description implies a showroom smash, so try the showrooms you find around Vice City.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Follow through on your throws — the trophy's wording points at completing a game there, not just visiting the alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A story moment — guides report this one pops during the campaign as the partnership story develops. Nothing to hunt: keep playing the story and it comes on its own.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile (GTABase). Robberies, fights and story choices all feed it, so it fills up through normal play — turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, to watch the count. Warning from GTABase: the Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes police more aggressive, so do not chase it on purpose.
trophies.caution: GTABase warns the Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent — do not chase it deliberately.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — the description suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something you failed once. No guide has confirmed the trigger yet; the likeliest reading is a retry that works, so if you fail an event or a challenge, try it again straight away.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Something strange happens — the description reads like a UFO or paranormal encounter. No guide has confirmed the trigger yet; keep an eye out for odd events while exploring, especially at night or in remote spots, and the trophy should pop when you witness one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — hit a target with a melee swing from a moving vehicle. The bowling name is a joke: the description points at a drive-by with a melee weapon, so equip one, drive past a target and swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — pass them to your contacts a little at a time and the total adds up. Keep robbing and laundering until the counter hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades as you play — the total is cumulative across every shop, so normal spending gets you most of the way there.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all the garage properties. Garages appear on the map as properties to purchase — buy each one as you can afford it. They also store the vehicles you collect, so they pay for themselves as your collection grows.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, add vehicles you own or find, and repeat until ten are registered.
trophies.name: On the Spot
